notes.title: Season 3 Trailer
notes.notes:
Season 3 is now complete and the trailer has been uploaded.
Game capacity is 450MB.
This is where the story ends.
We will release it once it has been reviewed by STEAM.
Season 4 is also planned, but player's HDD storage capacity is limited.
(It's free of course if you're the owner of this game.)

notes.title: Season 3?
notes.notes:
(It is not yet decided whether to develop it.)
Hi guys, I think that the sisters have to destroy the mother planet of the amazones.
And it should be FREE DLC.
By using the nuclear weapon ....uh,...you know, Force...and so on.
Licence of the FORCE is already taken by Jedi? Okay..
If we were to develop Season 3, it would take some time.
Thank you very much for your playing.

notes.notes:
The enemy's mother ship is equipped with many turrets, so it is difficult to destroy it.
If you are satisfied with just helping your sister, you cannot say you have completed this game.
